claims.originating_goal: Expose a user-facing, fail-closed Ecosystem Continuity panel that renders only authentic retained Site-safe ECE projection data and remains explicitly unavailable when no authentic projection exists.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after exact-head Site validations pass, panel source merges, and the claim is terminalized.
expected_evidence: panel does not synthesize current continuity state
only Site-safe projection fields are rendered
collision_boundaries: Site does not read raw ECE evidence or free-form diagnostic detail
Site does not mutate ECE findings or Healer remediation state
Do not publish a synthetic green fixture as current state
No second scheduler, heartbeat, WorkerCoordinator, evaluator, repair, credential, custody, or transition authority
claims.next_task_after_release: Bind the panel to an authentic retained resident Site-safe projection when one is observed; preserve unavailable state until then.
